name: auth-broker-go
description: Go port of auth-broker (fleet sign-in: GitHub device flow, Google and GitHub web flow with PKCE S256 and a single-use browser-bound state, Cloudflare One / Access JWT verification, email one-time code, the shared HMAC-signed session cookie), shadow stage: one container per provider on its own port, reading the Python service's build.json, outside every request path (ticket #1877). Parity harness drives the Python original with identical requests against stub providers.

native_build._doc: Multi-stage: compiled in golang:1.24-bookworm on the arch-matched runner, shipped as one static binary on distroless static (no shell, no libc, non-root 65532). No apt/apk line: the base has neither.

build.ship_hold: Shadow stage of the Go port (#1877): code and CI only. Not shipped until the hub is out of memory pressure (#1898) and the parity harness has been green for a release; shipping it earlier would add a second resident process next to the Python original.

api.description: Same contract as auth-broker: <prefix>/start, /device, /poll, /request, /verify, /callback, /auth, /cf-auth, /health per provider.

parity-compare.cmd: PYREF=$(ls -d /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.11*/x64/bin/python3 2>/dev/null | tail -1); ${PYREF:-python3} -m venv /tmp/ab-parity-venv && PY_BIN=/tmp/ab-parity-venv/bin/python PY_APP_DIR=$PWD/../../../infra-sec_auth-broker/src/code PARITY_REQUIRE=1 go test -count=1 -timeout 15m -tags parity -v -run TestParity ./parity/
parity-compare._doc: Reference = the Python service main.py (CPython 3.11, stdlib only) driven by parity/ref.py with a fake clock and a deterministic byte stream; the Go port gets the same. Every provider flow (device, web with PKCE and state, Cloudflare One, email one-time code) against stub providers; session cookies valid, expired, tampered, foreign-signed and hand-made; Cloudflare Access JWTs valid, expired, wrong kid, tampered, wrong audience/issuer/email, key rotation and the certs cache; the mail API and an SMTP-over-TLS server mocked; every request to the providers is compared too.

parity-mutation.cmd: PYREF=$(ls -d /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.11*/x64/bin/python3 2>/dev/null | tail -1); ${PYREF:-python3} -m venv /tmp/ab-parity-venv && o=$(mktemp); PY_BIN=/tmp/ab-parity-venv/bin/python PY_APP_DIR=$PWD/../../../infra-sec_auth-broker/src/code PARITY_MUTATE=1 PARITY_REQUIRE=1 go test -count=1 -timeout 15m -tags parity -run TestParityGoogle ./parity/ >"$o" 2>&1; grep -q 'requests differ' "$o"
parity-mutation._doc: Mutation proof: the Go side signs session cookies with another secret; the harness must report differing requests.

_doc_addressing: No mesh name on purpose during the shadow stage: nothing dials these containers, so they need no Hickory row and no Caddy fallback-map entry. Ports 4280-4283 sit beside the Python broker's 4180-4183 on the same host.
